changes: Lighting: ambient light, point lights, cones and shadows, with flicker, short light flashes and soft shadow edges.
Audio: sound now runs on miniaudio, with positioned sounds, live sounds, ambience layers, muffling, buses and music cross-fade.
Screen finish: film grain, colour fade and tint, wobble and tape distortion, mixable by one amount.
Atmosphere: rain, snow, dust, fog and lightning, driven by a Weather value.
Options screen: a Screen distortion row turns off grain, wobble and tape.
Editor: ctl audio capture, and ctl open with --set and --screenshot no longer fails on a busy editor.

breaking.change: SoundPlayer::Play(key, pitch) and PlayMusic(id, loop) take option structs.
breaking.migrate: Write Play(key, {.pitch = x}) and PlayMusic(id, {.loop = x}).

breaking.change: SoundOutput has voice calls instead of Play.
breaking.migrate: Only a SoundOutput of your own needs changes; see Docs/Audio.md.
Convert them to WAV, OGG, MP3 or FLAC.

breaking.change: Sounds mix slightly differently: a centred sound is 0.26 dB louder, and RestartNext fades the oldest copy out over 5 ms.
breaking.migrate: Nothing to do unless a mix was tuned to the decibel.

breaking.change: LightStyle is now RadialGlowStyle, and Blend::Multiply no longer changes what feeds bloom.
LightLayer softens shadow edges by default.
FxAction has new cases: FxLightFlash and FxBolt.
breaking.migrate: A std::visit of your own over FxAction needs a case for each.
